independentAxesDiff.method: Axes authored before comparing to file; scenario prose absent for 11/12 so ids used as scenario names

results.detail: Independent axes set verdict=indeterminate when requiredCoverageSatisfied=false. Author axes set verdict=pass. Both derive class indeterminate because derivation short-circuits on coverage before verdict. The axes are co-consistent with the derivation but **the pass verdict is not a faithful scenario model** — policy cannot honestly hold pass under required-coverage failure. This is exactly the mutual-consistency trap.

Independent axes use baselineRecipeSupported=false. Author models the case as requiredCoverageSatisfied=false + reason BASELINE.RECIPE_UNSUPPORTED. Recipe negotiation failure is **not** Coverage. Forcing Coverage false makes the derivation return indeterminate for the wrong reason and conflates remedies (upgrade baseline recipe vs widen analysis scope).

Axes carry errorCode IDENTITY.UNKNOWN while expectedTermination uses IDENTITY.NEVER_EXISTED. With tombstoneFound=false, IDENTITY.UNKNOWN is the coherent code per v1.2 tombstone rule; NEVER_EXISTED claims knowledge the axes do not support. Dual vocabulary between axes.errorCode and termination.errorCode is a second defect.
Author omits explicit interruption=none and finalizationCommitReached; defaults make derivation work. Prefer explicit axes for executability.
Independent axes match author; class success correct.
Match; finalizationCommitReached as INPUT suppresses interrupt — non-circular for this case.
Match on load-bearing durability flags; author errorCode field is supplementary.
Same UNKNOWN vs RESOLVER.EMPTY_DOMAIN / NEVER_EXISTED dual-code issue as AX-03; EMPTY_DOMAIN is the better specific code for latest-on-empty.

independentAxesDiff.summary: 12 reviewed; 2 high axis-modelling defects; 2 medium/low code-vocabulary issues; 8 ok. Derivation 39/39 does not catch AX-01/AX-02.

structuralFindings.title: Dual reason-code vocabularies
structuralFindings.detail: reasonCodeVocabulary lists COVERAGE.REQUIRED_MISSING etc., but golden expectedTermination.reasonCodes use required-coverage-missing kebab form. Closed vocabulary is not actually closed.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: One vocabulary; goldens and derivation emit only listed codes.

structuralFindings.title: exitCode still on HostTermination in 38/39 goldens
structuralFindings.detail: nullabilityPolicy says exitCode is NOT a union field and must not be stored on HostTermination. Almost every golden still carries exitCode in expectedTermination, reintroducing dual-source disagreement risk.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: Strip exitCode from HostTermination fixtures; assert classToExitCode(class) in the test harness only.

structuralFindings.title: Axes errorCode vs termination errorCode not identity-mapped
structuralFindings.detail: Multiple cases use different strings in scenarioAxes.errorCode and expectedTermination.errorCode (e.g. PROVIDER.PROTOCOL_VIOLATION vs PROVIDER.PROTOCOL). Without an explicit remap table, the axes are not the derivation input for codes.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: Either axes.errorCode IS the wire code, or document a pure remap function tested separately.

structuralFindings.title: finalizationCommitReached non-circular for listed rules but underspecified default
structuralFindings.detail: referenceDerivation treats finalizationCommitReached as input — good. When the field is absent, behaviour is implicit. Goldens should set it explicitly on all finite run cases.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: Default false in schema; require explicit bool on run/mutation analysis axes.

structuralFindings.title: absence-not-null policy is right; incomplete in fixtures
structuralFindings.detail: Policy ABSENT vs null is correct for wire. query-empty-search still uses identityResolved: null and completenessMet: null in axes — contradicts the policy for the axes document itself.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: Omit inapplicable keys entirely in scenarioAxes.

structuralFindings.title: Almost no scenario prose
structuralFindings.detail: Independent review asked for scenario prose; only 1/39 goldens has it. Ids are mnemonic but not a substitute for a falsifiable scenario sentence.
structuralFindings.requiredFix: Add one-line scenario to every golden.

circularity.detail: Ordered rules read input axes only; finalizationCommitReached is an input on interrupt cases. Caveat: baseline and coverage cases encode the *conclusion* (indeterminate) by setting coverage false rather than a first-class recipe axis — semantic circularity of modelling, not of the pure function.

reasonCodeRemedies.detail: Vocabulary note correctly separates SNAPSHOT.CONVERGENCE_EXHAUSTED from COVERAGE.REQUIRED_MISSING. Missing first-class BASELINE.RECIPE_UNSUPPORTED in the *same* enum that goldens emit; kebab codes break the closed set.

nullabilityPolicy.detail: ABSENT-not-null is correct. Fixtures and axes still use null and exitCode-on-term.

overall: v1.3 is a real advance (typed axes + executable derivation). It does **not** yet prove scenario faithfulness. Block seal on AX-01, AX-02, dual vocabularies, and exitCode-on-term. Confidence: high on findings; medium that v1.4 is one edit cycle away.
whatWouldChangeMyMind: Independent third authoring of all 39 axes matching Agent 3's without dual vocab, and baseline modelled with a first-class recipe axis.
knownLimitations: Only 12/39 goldens received full independent axis authoring.
Did not re-implement the derivation in a second language.
